PURCHASE AGREEMENT
Contract No.: NW-2026-0817
Date of signature: 2026-03-14
Buyer: Northwind Trading Company Limited
Registered address: 88 Harbour Road, Wellington
Seller: Contoso Manufacturing Group
Registered address: 21 Foundry Street, Sheffield
Article 1 - Price
The total contract price is USD 486,200.50,
inclusive of all taxes and delivery charges.
Article 2 - Payment
The Buyer shall pay the full amount within 45 days
after receipt of the goods and a valid invoice.
Article 3 - Delivery
Delivery shall be made to the Buyer's warehouse in Wellington.

Schedule A - Goods
Item                       Quantity   Unit price
Industrial bearing 6204        1200       18.50
Hydraulic seal kit HS-9         340       62.00
Precision shaft PS-220           75      410.40
End of Schedule A.
